scripts.test:adapter: npm run test:adapter:i3 && npm run test:adapter:rest
scripts.test:adapter:i3: esbuild --bundle tests/i3-adapter.test.ts --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist-tests-i3.cjs --log-level=error && node dist-tests-i3.cjs && rm -f dist-tests-i3.cjs
scripts.test:adapter:rest: esbuild --bundle tests/adapters.test.ts --platform=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist-tests-rest.cjs --log-level=error && node dist-tests-rest.cjs && rm -f dist-tests-rest.cjs
